nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Wire-format type definitions for the OpenAI Codex Responses API request shape.

nodes.name: ResponsesRequest
nodes.summary: Wire shape of the OpenAI Codex Responses API request body (model, input, instructions, reasoning, tools).

nodes.name: auth.rs
nodes.summary: Derives Cursor desktop-client authentication artifacts (checksum, machine IDs, client version, JWT extraction) from the local Cursor state database and session tokens.

nodes.name: cursor_state_db_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path to Cursor's local SQLite state database, which stores the session token and device identifiers.

nodes.name: cursor_client_version
nodes.summary: Reads the installed Cursor desktop client's version string from its state database, used to mimic a real client in request headers.

nodes.name: cursor_machine_ids
nodes.summary: Derives the machine/device identifiers Cursor's backend expects in request headers, matching what the real desktop client would send.

nodes.name: generate_checksum
nodes.summary: Computes Cursor's request checksum header value from machine identifiers and a timestamp, replicating the desktop client's anti-abuse signature.

nodes.name: extract_jwt
nodes.summary: Extracts and decodes the JWT claims embedded in a Cursor session token.

nodes.name: is_web_session_token
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given Cursor session token is a web-issued token (versus a desktop-app token), which affects which auth headers are required.

nodes.name: localtime_timezone
nodes.summary: Resolves the local system timezone identifier sent in Cursor request headers.

nodes.name: client.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level HTTP/2 Connect-RPC client that opens Cursor's agent.v1.AgentService/Run streaming connection, builds request headers, and decodes end-of-stream Connect error trailers.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formats a ClientError as a human-readable message, sanitizing any embedded HTTP error body via http_error_body::clean_error_message.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Sends one length-prefixed protobuf frame on the open RunStream connection to Cursor's backend.

nodes.name: for_testing
nodes.summary: Constructs a RunStream backed by an in-memory channel for use in pipeline_tests, bypassing the real HTTP/2 connection.

nodes.name: build_cursor_headers
nodes.summary: Builds the full set of HTTP headers (auth, checksum, client version, machine ids, timezone) required to open a Cursor agent run.

nodes.name: start_run
nodes.summary: Opens the HTTP/2 Connect-RPC streaming connection to Cursor's agent.v1.AgentService/Run endpoint and returns a RunStream for sending/receiving frames.

nodes.name: decode_end_stream_error
nodes.summary: Decodes a Connect-RPC end-of-stream trailer frame into a structured ClientError when the stream terminated with an error.

nodes.name: ClientError
nodes.summary: Error type returned by the Cursor Connect-RPC client, covering transport failures, decode errors, and Connect end-stream error codes.

nodes.name: RunStream
nodes.summary: Handle to an in-progress Cursor agent.v1.AgentService/Run streaming connection, used to send frames and receive server messages.

nodes.name: connect.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Connect-RPC's length-prefixed frame protocol (FrameParser) for incrementally parsing streamed protobuf messages and end-of-stream markers out of raw HTTP/2 byte chunks.

nodes.name: frame_message
nodes.summary: Encodes a protobuf message into a Connect-RPC length-prefixed frame ready to be written to the wire.

nodes.name: is_end_stream
nodes.summary: Reports whether this Frame's flags indicate it is the Connect-RPC end-of-stream marker frame.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty FrameParser with no buffered bytes.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Appends newly-received raw bytes to the FrameParser's internal buffer.

nodes.name: next_frame
nodes.summary: Attempts to parse and remove one complete length-prefixed Frame from the buffered bytes, returning None if not enough data has arrived yet.

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.summary: One parsed Connect-RPC frame: a flag byte plus its raw payload bytes.

nodes.name: FrameParser
nodes.summary: Incremental buffer that accumulates raw HTTP/2 byte chunks and yields complete Connect-RPC frames as they become available.

nodes.name: exec_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges Cursor's native exec server-message side-channel to ORGII's ToolCallRequest/ToolCallDelta model, translating MCP-fallback rejections, tool-call IDs, and Connect-RPC client errors into ORGII provider errors.

nodes.name: tool_definitions_enable_mcp_native_rejection
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current tool-definition set should cause native Cursor tools (shell/read/write) to be rejected in favor of MCP-routed equivalents.

nodes.name: shell_native_rejection
nodes.summary: Builds the rejection result returned to Cursor when a native shell exec call must be redirected through the MCP tool path instead.

nodes.name: is_orgii_mcp_args
nodes.summary: Detects whether an incoming exec server message's arguments correspond to ORGII's own MCP tool-call convention.

nodes.name: mcp_fallback_rejection_result
nodes.summary: Builds the fallback rejection payload sent back to Cursor when an MCP tool call cannot be routed natively.

nodes.name: mcp_native_fallback_result
nodes.summary: Builds the full native-tool-call fallback result (content, kind, pause state) when an MCP tool call must be executed via ORGII's native tool pipeline instead of Cursor's exec channel.

nodes.name: cursor_exec_to_tool_call
nodes.summary: Translates a Cursor native exec server message (shell/read/write/ls/grep/delete) into ORGII's internal ToolCallRequest shape.

nodes.name: cursor_tool_call_id
nodes.summary: Derives ORGII's internal tool-call id from a Cursor exec server message's identifying fields.

nodes.name: cursor_write_content
nodes.summary: Extracts the file content payload from a Cursor native write-file exec request.

nodes.name: handle_exec_server_message
nodes.summary: Top-level dispatcher that routes an incoming Cursor exec server message to either the native-tool bridge or the MCP fallback path, producing a paused tool call or an immediate result.

nodes.name: map_client_error
nodes.summary: Maps a Cursor Connect-RPC ClientError (including gRPC-style status codes) onto ORGII's ProviderError variants (auth, rate-limited, other).

nodes.name: summarise
nodes.summary: Produces a short, log-safe summary string for a Cursor exec server message.

nodes.name: ExecToolPause
nodes.summary: Represents a Cursor exec tool call that is paused awaiting an ORGII tool-call result before the run can continue.

nodes.name: ToolResultKind
nodes.summary: Distinguishes whether a paused exec tool result should be delivered back to Cursor via the native exec channel or the MCP channel.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Assorted helper functions supporting the Cursor native provider: conversation-id derivation, tool-continuation policy, message text extraction, and debug-friendly variant-name formatting for message enums.

nodes.name: stable_conversation_id
nodes.summary: Derives a stable Cursor conversation id from the session/workspace context so repeated turns in the same ORGII session map to the same Cursor conversation.

nodes.name: continuation_policy_for_tool
nodes.summary: Determines the ToolContinuationPolicy (how a paused tool result should be delivered back to Cursor) for a given tool name.

nodes.name: find_tool_result
nodes.summary: Locates the tool-result message in ORGII's message list matching a given tool-call id.

nodes.name: current_user_request_from_messages
nodes.summary: Extracts the current user-facing request text from the tail of ORGII's flat message list.

nodes.name: message_content_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text content from an ORGII chat message, regardless of its content-block shape.

nodes.name: tool_result_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text result payload from an ORGII tool-result message.

nodes.name: mcp_same_stream_result_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the result text to be sent back on the same MCP exec stream that a paused tool call arrived on.

nodes.name: send_tool_result_to_paused_run
nodes.summary: Delivers a completed tool-call result back into a paused Cursor run, encoding it via the native or MCP exec channel per the ToolContinuationPolicy and resuming the stream.

nodes.name: interaction_update_variant_name
nodes.summary: Returns a debug-friendly variant name string for a Cursor InteractionUpdate server message, used in logging.

nodes.name: server_message_variant_name
nodes.summary: Returns a debug-friendly variant name string for a Cursor server message, used in logging.

nodes.name: exec_message_variant_name
nodes.summary: Returns a debug-friendly variant name string for a Cursor exec server message, used in logging.

nodes.name: should_expose_as_cursor_native_mcp_tool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given ORGII tool should be advertised to Cursor as a native MCP tool definition.

nodes.name: build_request_context
nodes.summary: Builds the Cursor RequestContext protobuf block (workspace descriptors, advertised MCP tools) sent at the start of an agent run.

nodes.name: describe_workspace_context
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable description of the current workspace context, used in Cursor request metadata.

nodes.name: display_path
nodes.summary: Formats a filesystem path for display in Cursor request/log output.

nodes.name: cursor_mcp_tool_name_from_args
nodes.summary: Extracts the MCP tool name embedded in a Cursor exec call's arguments.

nodes.name: default_shell
nodes.summary: Returns the default shell executable path for the current platform (separate #[cfg(unix)] and #[cfg(windows)] implementations), used when Cursor requests a shell exec without an explicit shell.

nodes.name: interaction.rs
nodes.summary: Handles Cursor's InteractionUpdate side-channel messages (subagent task tracking, MCP tool-call resolution) and translates them into ORGII tool-call requests and KV blob replies.

nodes.name: handle_interaction_update
nodes.summary: Processes a Cursor InteractionUpdate server message (subagent task progress, MCP tool-call resolution) and translates it into ORGII tool-call/stream events, updating the InteractionToolStreamState.

nodes.name: reply_to_kv
nodes.summary: Sends a KV-store reply frame back to Cursor's backend answering a GetBlobArgs/interaction request.

nodes.name: cursor_mcp_tool_name
nodes.summary: Extracts the MCP tool name from a Cursor interaction tool-call message.

nodes.name: extract_mcp_args
nodes.summary: Extracts and decodes the MCP tool-call arguments protobuf Value from a Cursor interaction message.

nodes.name: log_interaction_tool_call
nodes.summary: Logs a Cursor interaction-channel tool call for debugging/observability.

nodes.name: interaction_tool_call_to_orgii_request
nodes.summary: Translates a Cursor interaction-channel MCP tool call into ORGII's internal ToolCallRequest shape.

nodes.name: cursor_task_to_agent_tool_call
nodes.summary: Translates a Cursor subagent task update into an ORGII agent tool-call representation.

nodes.name: cursor_subagent_type_to_agent_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Cursor subagent type identifier onto ORGII's internal agent id.
